_about.what: Numeric look-targets for 'Эхо Разлома' sampled from references/img (60 CC/PD photos) + physical rules. Compare against game screenshots with the same method.

method.Y: relative luminance, linear-light Rec.709 (0..1) after sRGB decode
method.snow_mask: lower 60% of frame, HSV-saturation<0.45, B>=R-15, max(RGB)>40
method.snow_lit: top 20% of snow_mask by Y; median RGB (sRGB 0..255)
method.snow_shadow: 10th..30th percentile of snow_mask by Y (skips rocks/black); median RGB
method.dark_frac_midband: share of pixels with Y<0.02 in rows 35..75% (silhouette density: trees, rocks, buildings)

_about.caveat: Photos are long exposures: real eye sees night ~10-100x darker and less saturated. Use colour RATIOS and hue as primary targets, absolute Y as the 'photographic' look the game grades toward. Categories c,d,e,i,j are mostly daylight: take SHAPE/MATERIAL cues from them, colours from 'night_master'.

targets.snow_shadow_hex: #353a3c median .. #4a5a70 (shadow is BLUER than lit: B/R 1.3-1.6)
targets.warm_window_hex: #cb9460 measured (2700-3200 K); emissive Y 5-20x lit snow

physics.shadow_penumbra_width_m: 0.009 x occluder-to-ground distance (1 m -> 9 mm, 10 m -> 9 cm, 20 m tree -> 18 cm): moon shadows stay crisp at all game distances; they fade by haze/contrast, not blur
physics.shadow_visible_distance_m: crisp-edged shadows readable to 80-150 m on open snow in full moon; cascade coverage >= 80 m recommended
physics.aurora_shadows: aurora is a wide area source -> very soft/no shadows, only a green tint on upward-facing snow

a.name: Ночь, снег, сияние, луна
a.aurora_frame_coverage: 7-44% of frame in photos; target 10-25% of sky area
a.aurora_reflect_on_snow: snow picks up green tint: lit snow G/R 1.1-1.5 under strong aurora (a03,a04)
a.stars: visible, 2000-5000 per hemisphere to naked eye; Milky Way only without moon

b.name: Ель в снегу, ночь/сумерки
b.snow_load: crown 'snow ghosts': 30-100% of needles hidden, blobs 0.3-1 m, drooping lower branches

c.name: Следы и ботинки
c.print_interior: deep blue shadow: inner Y 0.3-0.5x surrounding snow (c03 ratio 2.5)
c.wall: near-vertical in cold powder, crumbled rim, snow clods thrown forward

d.name: Валуны, скалы, надувы
d.cap_shape: rounded pillow, overhang (cornice) on lee side
d.lee_drift_length: 3-10x obstacle height downwind; windward side scoured to bare rock
d.rock_colour: dark grey, slightly warm vs blue snow

e.name: Тундра: кусты и трава из-под снега
e.species: dwarf birch (Betula nana), polar willow, crowberry, sedge/grass tufts
e.exposed_fraction_windswept: 10-40% of ground shows vegetation/tussocks on ridges; 0-5% in hollows
e.colour: dry grass straw #b69a6a, shrubs rusty-brown #6b4a38, both desaturated at night (~40% of daylight saturation)

f.name: Полярная станция, тёплые окна
f.light_pool_on_snow: warm pool falls off ~1/r^2, snow in pool 3-10x brighter than moonlit snow
f.structure: modular blocks on stilts 1.5-3 m (f03 Halley VI, f04 Summit), antenna masts 10-30 m, radome, drifts piled to windward sides
f.red_beacon: small red obstruction lights on masts (f02)

g.name: Лёд: озеро/море, трещины, торосы, айсберги
g.lake_black_ice: clear black ice Y 0.03-0.1 with white crack planes (g03, g06); crack spacing 1-10 m, cracks look like white feathered planes
g.iceberg_frozen_in: tabular/irregular, 5-30 m high, blue-white faces, snow moat around base

h.name: Горы ночью / синий час
h.far_contrast_loss: mountains at 5-15 km keep 40-80% of near contrast in clear arctic air

i.name: Северные олени
i.coat: grey-brown body, pale/white neck and rump, dark legs; winter coat thick
i.behaviour: herds 5-50, dig feeding craters 30-60 cm wide, trails in single file

j.name: Обломки самолёта в снегу
j.ref_airframe: Douglas DC-3/C-47: fuselage 19.7 m, dia ~2.5 m, wingspan 29 m
j.skin: weathered aluminium, matte grey #a8acb0 daylight, dents, torn edges, missing panels
j.burial: snow drifted to 30-70% of fuselage height on windward side, cap of snow on top
